map.note: The archived PMTiles identify the grove, paths and river. The published sculpture marker fixes a draft location in the western grove. Exact site geometry and signed facing remain pending.

courtyard.label: Iyamopo Courtyard
courtyard.note: The Falade and Taiwo locality map places Iyamapo on the western side of the grove. The point near the mapped access route denotes the wider courtyard. It supplies no signed sculpture axis.

surveySculpture.basis: The marked sculpture is separated from the similarly named point 21 beside the river. The depicted pad is obscured in the retained overhead imagery.

limitations: The model interprets the photographed exterior and the published plan. Dimensions and surface relief are approximations, and archive captions give different overall heights.
The visual reconstruction covers the main figure, modeled birds, basin and mosaic. The ritual interior and adjacent shrines are outside this asset.
The survey point supports a draft location in the western grove. The signed facing and the exact grade under the extended forms remain unresolved.

The stone apron is confined to the torso and vessels. Its boundaries and paving joints follow the visible area in the restoration footage, with approximate dimensions. Native landcover occupies the gaps around the trailing sculpture.
